name: Bird-Dog Row on Bench
description: A bird-dog performed on a flat bench holding a dumbbell, combining the spinal stability demands of the bird-dog with a rowing motion. The bench elevates the hands and allows the working arm to row while the opposite leg extends. This integrates core stability with pulling strength.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Bird-Dog Row on Bench in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Bird-Dog Row on Bench.
steps: Step 1: Kneel on bench with one hand holding dumbbell below.
Step 2: Extend opposite leg behind, maintaining level pelvis.
Step 3: Row dumbbell to ribs while keeping hips and shoulders square.
Step 4: Lower dumbbell and return leg, then repeat.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
common_mistakes: Rotating hips to assist the row
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Imagine a glass of water on your lower back
